Rus ki ek misail bite kuchh vakt se charcha men hai. yah misail chhoti aur sanbhvat kam lagat vali bataee jati hai, lekin iski kshamtaen kaphi asardar mani ja rahi hai. rus bite kuchh vakt se yukren ke khilaf hamle karne ke lie is kruz misail ka istemal kar raha hai. iska nam hai philin kruz misail. rus ki yah misail kitni asardar hai aur iski kya-kya khubiyan hain?
